description:
The Saksham Yuva Scheme was launched by the Government of Haryana on 1st April 2016. 

This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to unemployed youth in the state. 

The primary objective of the Saksham Yuva Scheme is to empower young individuals by providing them with a monthly stipend. 

The scheme specifically targets youth aged between 21 to 35 years. 

Eligible candidates must be residents of Haryana and should have completed their education at least up to the 10th standard. 

The scheme is designed to encourage youth to seek employment opportunities and enhance their skills. 

Under the Saksham Yuva Scheme, eligible beneficiaries receive a monthly stipend of ₹3,000. 

Those who possess a graduate degree or higher are entitled to a stipend of ₹6,000 per month. 

The scheme also aims to provide skill development training to the youth. 

This training is intended to enhance employability and prepare them for the job market. 

The Saksham Yuva Scheme has a target to benefit approximately 1 lakh youth annually. 

The financial assistance is provided for a maximum period of 3 years. 

To apply for the Saksham Yuva Scheme, candidates must visit the official website of the Haryana Government. 

They must create an account on the portal and fill out the application form. 

Required documents include proof of residence, educational certificates, and a recent passport-sized photograph. 

Candidates must also provide their Aadhaar number for verification purposes. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

Successful applicants receive a notification regarding the approval of their application. 

The stipend is disbursed directly into the bank accounts of the beneficiaries. 

The disbursement occurs on a monthly basis. 

The Saksham Yuva Scheme is implemented by the Department of Skill Development and Industrial Training, Haryana. 

The department is responsible for overseeing the application process and ensuring timely disbursement of funds. 

The scheme has been well-received in Haryana, with many youth benefiting from the financial assistance. 

As of 2023, the scheme has successfully registered over 2 lakh applicants since its inception. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹100 crores for the Saksham Yuva Scheme for the financial year 2023-2024. 

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of self-employment. 

Youth are encouraged to explore entrepreneurial opportunities. 

The government provides additional support for those interested in starting their own businesses. 

This includes access to training programs and workshops on entrepreneurship. 

The Saksham Yuva Scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Haryana Government to reduce unemployment rates. 

The unemployment rate in Haryana was approximately 9.6% in 2021. 

The government aims to lower this rate significantly through various employment schemes. 

The Saksham Yuva Scheme is one of the flagship programs in this regard. 

The scheme has also been instrumental in promoting skill development among the youth. 

Skill development training programs are conducted in collaboration with various training institutes. 

These institutes provide courses in various sectors such as IT, hospitality, and manufacturing. 

The government has partnered with organizations like the National Skill Development Corporation. 

This partnership aims to ensure that the training provided is relevant to the current job market. 

The Saksham Yuva Scheme also includes provisions for regular monitoring and evaluation. 

The Department of Skill Development conducts periodic reviews to assess the impact of the scheme. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the program further. 

The scheme has also been instrumental in creating awareness about government employment initiatives. 

Workshops and seminars are organized to educate youth about available opportunities. 

The Saksham Yuva Scheme has received positive feedback from various stakeholders. 

Many beneficiaries have reported improved job prospects after receiving training and financial assistance. 

The scheme has also contributed to the overall economic development of the state. 

By empowering youth, the government aims to create a skilled workforce. 

This workforce is essential for attracting investments and promoting industrial growth in Haryana. 

The Saksham Yuva Scheme is a crucial step towards achieving the goal of a self-reliant India. 

The scheme aligns with the national vision of enhancing youth employability. 

The government continues to explore ways to expand and improve the Saksham Yuva Scheme. 

Future plans include increasing the stipend amounts and expanding the eligibility criteria. 

The scheme is expected to evolve based on the changing needs of the youth and the job market. 

The Haryana Government remains committed to supporting its youth through various welfare schemes. 

The Saksham Yuva Scheme is a testament to this commitment. 

The scheme serves as a model for other states to replicate similar initiatives. 

Overall, the Saksham Yuva Scheme is a comprehensive approach to tackling unemployment among youth in Haryana. 

It provides financial assistance while also focusing on skill development and employability. 

The scheme's success will play a vital role in shaping the future of Haryana's economy. 

The government encourages all eligible youth to take advantage of the Saksham Yuva Scheme. 

This initiative is a significant step towards building a prosperous and self-sufficient state.
